title: ExpenseIQ
subtitle: Personal Finance SaaS
description: A production-grade serverless SaaS application built on AWS, featuring expense tracking, budget management, Stripe payments, and a real-time analytics dashboard.
longDescription: ExpenseIQ is a full-stack personal finance SaaS deployed on AWS serverless infrastructure. The NestJS backend runs on AWS Lambda via API Gateway, the React frontend is served from S3 via CloudFront CDN, and all secrets are managed through SSM Parameter Store with IAM-scoped access. Features include JWT authentication, Stripe premium subscriptions, and a Recharts analytics dashboard.
highlights: Deployed NestJS backend to AWS Lambda via serverless-http, exposed through API Gateway for a fully serverless architecture
Migrated React frontend to S3 static hosting distributed globally via CloudFront CDN with custom error handling
Implemented private S3 bucket for receipt storage with presigned URLs for secure, scalable file access
Stored all production secrets in AWS SSM Parameter Store with IAM-scoped access — no environment file dependencies
Configured GitHub Actions CI/CD for automatic S3 and Lambda deployments on every push, with Lambda warmer to prevent cold starts
JWT authentication with bcrypt hashing, route guards, and role-based access for Free and Premium tiers
Stripe Checkout with webhook handling to toggle premium status, PostgreSQL schema via TypeORM in Supabase
Analytics dashboard with Recharts charts and backend alert logic for 80%/100% budget threshold breaches

title: PoolRide
subtitle: Carpooling & Bike-Pooling Platform
description: A full-stack mobile platform with dual-role functionality, smart matching algorithms, real-time chat, map routing, and a complete Stripe escrow payment system.
longDescription: PoolRide is a full-stack mobile carpooling platform built with React Native and NestJS. It features dual-role functionality for drivers and riders, a matching algorithm, real-time chat via Socket.io, map routing through OpenRouteService API, and a Stripe escrow system with automated platform fee deduction and fund disbursement.
highlights: Dual-role matching algorithm for drivers and riders with availability management
Stripe escrow with automated 15% platform fee calculation and fund disbursement
Real-time chat via Socket.io with push notifications
Map routing integration via OpenRouteService API
